policy.latency_source: client-side wall clock, steady-state median of back-to-back measured requests after warmup; server-side timers kept only as per-framework diagnostics
policy.selection: best lossless profile per case for the hardware this ran on (see each row's profile; configs/benchmark/SELECTED.md lists what the harness selects)
policy.cache: no response cache, no Cache-DiT, no quantized checkpoints
policy.torch_compile: ON for the competitors; sglang runs compile-off by policy (its fused kernels match or beat compiler fusion, measured)
policy.attention: each framework runs its fastest exact-precision attention; no quantized or approximate substitution
policy.version_policy: latest-vs-latest: sglang runs origin/main HEAD, every competitor runs its newest main/release line (no pinned snapshots)
policy.sglang: main 25c1c43942 (2026-11-16) for every cell: one pass on one RunPod 4xB300 box (b300r1116), each case through its selected B300 profile, no local patches. The H3 throughput cell is sglang DP2 (dp2-throughput), run on the same box after the matrix. Details in reports/round-20261116/manifest.json.
policy.vllm_omni: main 24e5472849 (vllm-omni 0.33.0rc2.dev319) on vllm 0.33.0, torch 2.14.0, for every cell; the H3 throughput cell is replica2-throughput. Against 2026-10-22 vLLM-Omni is faster in all 13 cells both rounds measured (1.4% to 23.2%) while sglang moved by at most 5.4%, so every lead is thinner than that round's. Not bisected; the Cosmos3 and H3 checkpoints are also newer revisions.
policy.throughput: MiniMax-H3 throughput compares the multi-replica modes where a framework has one: sglang DP2 (one replica per GPU) against vLLM-Omni replica data parallelism 2, three interleaved rounds each on GPUs 0,1 (sglang 238.56 / 238.567 / 238.555 s, vLLM-Omni 244.501 / 244.53 / 244.52 s for 4 requests at concurrency 2; the median round of each is published). LightX2V, TRT-LLM and FastVideo have no multi-replica profile and run their 2-GPU intra-request command; ComfyUI runs on one GPU.
policy.harness: round-20261116: 1ba140e60 image half, 500aa7afb video half and the H3 throughput arms (driven by scripts/run_plan_ab.sh, 905d82d)
policy.video_encode: every configurable framework encodes the MP4 like its closest competitor; TRT-LLM and LightX2V hard-code x264 medium/CRF 23
policy.coverage: 15 cases in one pass on one box. LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 retired after 2026-10-22 and keep their rows in that round, not here; minimax_h3_t2va_480p_1gpu is the single-32 GB consumer case and is not part of a 4-GPU round; LightX2V Cosmos3 T2I is failed (HTTP 500 in its image encoder, recorded in the cell).
policy.checkpoint_revisions: the MiniMax-H3, Cosmos3-Nano and FLUX.3-klein-base checkpoints are newer Hugging Face revisions than in 2026-10-22; every framework in this round loads the same one, so ratios are like-for-like and absolute times are not strictly comparable with that round for those three cases.

summary.note: Steady-state single-request latency on 4x NVIDIA B300 288GB, best lossless config per framework. SGLang-Diffusion fastest in 15/15 comparable cases across 15 cases. Throughput is reported separately.

V2 is trained for VIDEO_SPARSE_ATTN_H3 at 0.8 sparsity on 64-token tiles, and LightX2V has no VSA backend (its sparse attentions -- Sparge, SVG, radial, NBHD, Sol-Attn, sparse Sage/FA4 -- are other methods; dense attention would run a different model). Its H3 scheduler builds only a uniform shifted grid from infer_steps, so the explicit rungs [999, 874, ..., 125] cannot be given (an 8-step grid starts at 1000). LightX2V's own few-step H3 paths (configs/minimax_h3/dmd/: 4- and 8-step LoRAs on the base checkpoint, mostly FP8/INT8) are a different distillation, not this checkpoint, and are not substituted.

trtllm-visual.reason: trtllm-visual's tracked scope in this harness is image cases; H3 is a video+audio model.

comfyui.reason: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates templates/video_fastvideo_fasth3_t2v.json exists (since 2026-09-22), but it runs int8 dense attention and VSA keeping 10% of tiles from step 0.2 -- a different numeric class and a different sparsity from the case's BF16 VSA at the trained 80% (64-token tiles). Re-checked 2026-10-22.
